historical_reviews.deepseek: Correct hybrid direction but its quoted command is unsafe/malformed and count-only evidence can misread SMBIOS/topology.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds installation/cooling controls, raw per-socket topology, BIOS/OS reconciliation and no automatic power-cycle.

original_test_intent: Verify a fully populated two-socket system powers on and both BIOS and Linux report the approved processor models, sockets, cores and threads.
original_method: Qualified operator installs CPUs/cooling with power removed, powers on and captures BIOS; after stable Linux boot, agent securely records raw lscpu, dmidecode, /proc and sysfs topology plus health logs; engineer reconciles counts with platform spec.
manual_activity: Qualified operator installs both CPUs/cooling, powers on and captures BIOS/KVM; agent may collect secure read-only OS topology afterward.
required_inputs: Approved CPU pair, motherboard, socket map, cooling, BIOS/firmware and hardware recipe
Qualified operator and ESD/power isolation plus local console/KVM
Expected sockets, model, cores/socket, threads/core and online/offline policy
Approved Linux plus dmidecode/lscpu/sysfs and secure access
Thermal/power/SEL abort and hardware recovery policy
safety_requirements: Never install or reseat CPUs energized; verify cooling and compatibility before power
Use qualified operator, ESD and platform torque/handling procedure
Use secure authenticated OS access; no sshpass or disabled host verification
Stop on missing socket, thermal/SEL error, unstable boot or topology contradiction
No automatic BIOS change, reboot, power-cycle or reseat
agent_execution_scope: Collect raw lscpu, dmidecode, /proc and sysfs topology plus online state after operator approval
Compare BIOS/OS evidence with supplied topology without DUT verdict
Do not perform physical install, claim BIOS view, alter topology/power or recover hardware
engineer_actions: Approve hardware recipe and expected topology
Ensure qualified installation and BIOS evidence
Resolve BIOS/OS mismatches and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Conceptually useful but unsafe SSH and nested quoting are rejected; grep counts alone do not distinguish populated/enabled sockets, cores, threads and online state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After operator boot approval, run raw `lscpu`, `dmidecode -t processor`, `/proc/cpuinfo` and `/sys/devices/system/cpu` topology checks via managed authenticated access; preserve full outputs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Two sockets, BIOS and Linux checks, full CPU/core/thread criteria and20/25 planning fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Reconcile per-socket BIOS identity with raw OS topology and online state under a signed hardware manifest.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secure access, raw evidence, online/offline mapping, cooling/thermal safety and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: OS counts alone cannot prove correct BIOS enumeration or physical installation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS can expose empty sockets and disabled/offline CPUs; topology must be cross-checked across sources.

project_override_considerations: Project may define permitted offline cores or firmware topology, but must provide expected matrix; no values are inferred.
expected_evidence: Operator/date, CPU serial/model pair, board/BIOS/firmware and install/cooling checklist
BIOS/KVM screenshots showing both processor sockets
Raw lscpu, dmidecode, /proc and sysfs topology/online evidence
Temperatures, power, dmesg/syslog/SEL and boot errors
Stable final state and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and criteria consistently require two installed CPUs, BIOS/OS enumeration and spec matching. Missing expected topology is a project readiness input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Hardware, operator, BIOS evidence and OS tooling can be supplied; manual setup plus automatable inventory makes the case RPUC rather than inherently blocked.

review_improvement: Separates manual hardware/BIOS proof from secure raw OS topology and prevents count-only or unsafe SSH evidence from implying full two-socket correctness.
independent_technical_reasoning: `dmidecode` may list unpopulated sockets and `/proc/cpuinfo` reports logical CPUs rather than socket population. Correct validation needs per-socket SMBIOS status, lscpu topology, online CPU maps and BIOS identity together. Physical cooling and installation also determine whether power-on is safe, which remote commands cannot attest.
